Rig assumptions & calibration

Original CAD solids. Joint locations inferred from named parts. STEP does not provide motion mates, actuator limits or a control law.

Actuator reference: 20 mm; travel: 0–50 mm in standalone mode; drive limits apply with the ankle bridge. Readouts are calculated geometric estimates. No force, collision, balance or motor dynamics solver.

Motor configuration & live monitor

Signed positions start at your saved zero. PID changes are explicit; limits and zero capture require Stop and Disarm.

Read hardware to load device settings. No homing movement is performed.

Settings are saved in the bridge profile. Motor writes are acknowledged and read back; device flash is not automatically saved. Unavailable measurements are never shown as zero consumption.
